includes.why: reads the listen address from HOST so the backend can bind to loopback
runs the backend on an in-process PGlite for a pglite:// database URL, with PGLITE_ASSETS_DIR and PGLITE_SHARED_BUFFERS
lets the CLI take its token and data key from a command named by AGENT_BOARD_CREDENTIALS_COMMAND

makes the version machine command name the machine a token belongs to, and makes board init take that name and check the token and the data key with the board before writing anything, with the fixes formerly on init-force-verify
adds board internal shutdown, which ends a worker and its runs within a grace period, with the fixes formerly on shutdown-idle-agent, kill-who-fallback and no-self-signal-in-tests
stops the worker signalling an agent's process group once it has ended (stored and cleared escalation timer, no terminate() after exit, groupExists guards in endGroup and runLimited)
refuses requests whose Host is not the proxy's, so a page cannot reach the no-login backend by DNS rebinding

reason: The fork's local-server-v2 branch is the fork's main (3a546ec) plus the included branches, changes a single-machine server needs that upstream does not have yet. local-server stays at the pre-login pin b587c6a.
